title: An old fade callback hides the tab panel that has become active again
status: confirmed by own source review and bounded local execution
expected: After rapidly selecting A→B→A, A remains visible and aria-selected agrees with visible content.
actual: Real Chrome on first-5-minutes: start bun-node, click vscode then bun-node in the same task; after400ms active=bun-node but all3panels hidden. A normal keyboard ArrowRight control selects/shows vscode.
rootCause: Outgoing animationend callbacks and260ms fallback timers unconditionally hide their captured panel; reactivation does not cancel them or check current active id.
impact: Fast tab changes leave the content area blank while the tab remains selected.
recommendation: Cancel prior hide callbacks or use an activation generation/current-active guard before hiding.

verification.confidence: high within the stated fixture/host boundaries

relationship: No same cause found in108ownfindings and283joint points. Related UI/i18n findings are narrower/different causes.
limits: Actual unmodified UI built from fixed source with synthetic capabilities and real generated skills/pages. This is Chrome, not every browser.
regressionTest: Click A→B→A before260ms, advance timers/animationend; exactly active panel stays visible.
resolution: Deferred for joint consensus; no product fix

title: Tabs and copy buttons stop binding after an Astro client navigation
status: confirmed by own source review and bounded local execution

excerpt.text:
<script>
	/**
	 * Tabs controller — keyboard + cross-fade glue. Kept in
	 * apps/web/src/components/ui/_tabs-controller.ts because the
	 * scope of the controller is per-page (driven by `[data-ui-tabs]`
	 * roots in the document) and the script lives alongside the
	 * Astro components that produce those roots. The renderer
	 * itself is host-agnostic; this site-specific glue is the seam.
	 */
	import { initTabs } from './_tabs-controller';
	initTabs(document);
</script>

<script>
	/**
	 * Copy-button runtime glue — handled by the controller in
	 * apps/web. The shared renderer just emits the markup;
	 * this `<script>` wires `data-copy-target` to the matching
	 * `<code id>` and toggles `data-state="copied"`. The runtime
	 * glue is site-specific because it depends on `navigator.
	 * clipboard` and the i18n dictionary of the page.
	 */
	import { initCopyButtons } from './_code-copy-controller';
	initCopyButtons(document);
</script>

<script>
	import { initCopyButtons } from './_code-copy-controller';
	initCopyButtons(document);
</script>

expected: Controls in each newly swapped main subtree are initialized after client navigation.
actual: Real Chrome direct first-5-minutes has bound=1; clicking actual nav home link produces3new roots with bound/active=null. Clicking Python leaves its panel hidden; clicking a copy control leaves bound/state null.
rootCause: Component module scripts call initTabs/initCopyButtons only once; neither registers astro:page-load, and Astro reuses already executed modules across these transitions.
impact: Install ecosystem tabs and copy controls become inert when arriving through normal in-site navigation; a hard reload masks the fault.
recommendation: Initialize the idempotent controllers on astro:page-load as well as initial load, or delegate events at a persistent root.

verification.confidence: high within the stated fixture/host boundaries

relationship: No same cause found in108ownfindings and283joint points. Related UI/i18n findings are narrower/different causes.
limits: The reproduction uses actual first5→home link navigation, no injected app router. Clipboard content itself was not read; unbound/no visual state is observed and tab nonresponse is directly observed.
regressionTest: Load first5, navigate via a real link to home, activate Python and copy; assert visibility/copy callback.
resolution: Deferred for joint consensus; no product fix

title: Tutorial translation parity accepts equal counts with different slugs
status: confirmed by own source review and bounded local execution

actual: Calling actual exported runCheck with en/wanted and es/orphan returns parityProblems=[]; same-slug control also returns[]. Existing orphan test only passes because an unrelated locale is missing and bypasses the early continue.

title: A failed brand refresh deletes the existing cached logo
status: confirmed by own source review and bounded local execution
expected: When all sources for a brand fail, preserve its last known logo and report the refresh failure.
actual: The unmodified entrypoint in an owned fixture begins with npm.svg. Injected fetch rejects every call; script reports18failed and removes npm.svg as stale.
rootCause: Cleanup considers every configured brand eligible for stale-file removal, rather than only brands successfully refreshed during this run.
impact: A transient/offline refresh converts existing valid assets into missing images.
recommendation: Remove alternative extensions only for brands with a successfully validated replacement.

title: HTML gateway responses are accepted and written as SVG logos
status: confirmed by own source review and bounded local execution
